batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c RS Bopara b J Theron

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b IK Pathan

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b SE Bond

balls.text: 200 up, comes up with an edge past the makeshift wicketkeeepr, Bisla - a regulation golveman would have taken that
Mathews shimmies down, is beaten by the full and wide delivery, Bisla gets the ball back quickly to Shakabh, and prevents the bye
low full toss, drags it to the on side, comes off the bottom part of the bat, one-bounce to long-on
incredible shot, another wide yorker, and despite having backed away, he reaches across and steers it to the left of point and right of third man
well bowled, beats a backing-away Hussey with a wide yorker
gets bat to this wide yorker, and takes a single to third man
same delivery, slightly wider, and this time rightly penalised
oh that's harsh! beats him with a full and wide yorker, and has been wided even though it went inside that white line
superb strike from Hussey, this one missed the yorker length by inches, and he got under it and lofted it over long-off, thereby spoiling a good over from Irfan
full and wide yorker, slower one too, and Hussey is beaten
Kaif shows the main team how to catch it! Slower ball mis-hit - Kaif settles under it at the edge of the boundary at long-on, and gets the reverse cup right for this overhead catch
full and wide, the thick outside edge results in a single
length ball, driven past extra cover for two
shapes up to sweep him, IKP bowls a full and wide yorker, and he gets only a single in the end
again Theron provides them with length to get under, and again he is punished. Nothing to take away from this sweet shot, though - he stepped down the pitch and lofted him straight over his head
another full toss, high but not high enough to be called no-ball, and it cramps him up too - just a single to extra cover
full toss but hit straight to long-off
yorker length here, driven down to long-on
full and straight now, hit to deep square leg, Mahela's direct hit from there ends up going for an overthrow
Theron gives him the length ball, and has been swatted to the midwicket boundary
shuffles across, but Irfan keeps his full length, and all he manages is a single to long-on
mis-hits an attempted straight hit, Bopara makes a good diving save at extra cover
swept away to short fine for one
length ball, hit down to long-on for one
full and straight, hit down to long-on where Kaif is the substitute fielder
slower ball, driven down to long-off for a single
another yorker, another single
yorker, digs it out for a single

the cyclone has run its course, has left back destruction, but missed out on a century, looks to send this low full toss into the stands again, but gets the outside half of the bat to wide long-off, and for a change Punjab hold on to a catch
that's a Gayle mis-it! comfortably over long-on! "Gayle has been a cyclone," says the ever-resourceful Jeremy Coney, Gayle gets length and is under it and brings up the 100-run partnership
back of a length, pushed wide of Theron for a single, he fields and hits the stumps direct even while off balance, but Tiwary has made it
full and wide, drilled down to long-off for one

another catch dropped, Ganguly can't help his laughter in the dugout! This is a top-edged skier, Chawla calls for it, Chawla gets under it, Chawla waits for ages for it to come down, Chawla lets it slip out. Dada is cracking up, Amul Butter wants its logo on those Punjab fingers
bye bye ball! Makes no difference, that angle, Chawla tries a googly but it is way too overpitched and in a flash it is among the crowd behind long-off
tries a googly, Tiwary pushes it to deep midwicket for one
short and quick, almost seam-up, cuts it uppishly, one bounce to deep point
into the construction debris again! flighted on the pads, Gayle sits back, picks the googly early, and slogs it over midwicket
gives Chawla the charge, gets too close to it, gets a single off the mis-hit to long-on
another nice yorker outside off, Gayle can't reach it after having backed away a touch
pushed to long-off for a single
it indeed is pouring, this time Tiwary edges a slower delivery, wide of keeper, fine of third man
nice yorker, just outside off, can't do much with those
when it rains, it pours! Gayle clears the front leg for the big shot into the leg side, and the inside edge goes between his legs and past Bisla for four
slower ball pushed down to long-on for one
full ball, and Tiwary is Mother Teresa compared to Gayle, compassionately pushes it down to long-off for one
slower ball, wide outside leg, and this is now the most expensive over in all IPL matches
Oh Punjab have been destroyed here, fires in a full ball down the leg side, five wides - 30 off five balls

Bopara is getting his figures rearranged here, and in one over we have lost two balls! Kookaburra manufacturers, get a few more boxes to Kolkata! Steps down this time, and gets under a length ball again, and over long-on, into the debris. There is debris outside the playing, there is debris inside the playing field
his best shot of the day! down on a knee, and goes over extra cover, beautiful
and again, this is gone into the construction debris! and it's 50 off 30 balls, and only about five minutes ago he was seemingly going too slow! overpitched and walloped over long-on
that's the Gayle we know! He is not waiting too long today! sits back in the crease, waits for the length ball, and lofts it over midwicket
stays low a touch, gets a bottom edge onto his pad as he looks to pull

and that's an old-fashioned, sets himself up for this flighted delivery, and gets lots of power behind this shot, and it hasn't gone too far wide of long-on, but it is too fast for the fielder to get around
Gayle opens up, pitched up on off, and he murders it over extra cover
flicked away from outside off, into the leg side for one

Tiwary is getting desperate here, charging out too early, and ends up yorking himself. "Superb bowling Pushy," says Bisla. Pushy is the nickname Chawla gets from Sussex where he replaced Mushtaq "Mushy" Ahmed
they are staying on Gayle's pad here, cramping him up, just a leg-bye
starts with one pitched up outside off, and is driven down to long-on for a single
Gayle doesn't give him a nice send-off at all! Sees his good spell off with a six over long-on, steps out again, gets close to the ball this time and swings cleanly
superbly bowled again, sees him charge down, and bowls this flat, on the pads
pushed to long-on for another single
Gayle comes out of the crease again, and is not close to the pitch of it, and pushes it down to long-on
Tiwary gives him the charge again, gets too close to it, and doesn't get the elevation on this shot, and gets just a single
flighted around the pads, yorks him
yorker outside off, digs it out for a single to point
angled into the pads, worked away smartly square of fine leg and comes back for two
shorter this time and hit straight to long-on this time
full ball, hit powerfully and wide of long-on, and comes back for two
short, into the pads, worked away for a single
full ball, driven crisply to extra cover
full delivery, pushed down to long-on for a single
gives him the charge again, and hits him one bounce to long-on
Tiwary comes down to get to the pitch of the ball, and takes a single to long-on
overpitched on the pads, pushed to long-on for one
tossed up again, yorks him, and hit back to Powar
lovely bowling, dip and turn, and slow too, at 81ks, and Gayle is made to stretch by the dip, and then is beaten by the turn away
driven through the covers, will get a single
length ball, hit to the right of Bopara who does the fielding
steered to third man to get off the mark
full toss, hit back to Bopara on the bounce
and Bopara gets a typical Harris dismissal here, 115ks, stopping at Ganguly, and a fine low return catch off this sort of leading edge by Bopara. Eat your heart out, Harry
full and straight, hit down to long-on
tosses this one up, it lands on a yorker length, and is hit back to him
Ganguly steps out of his crease, Powar bowls flat, cramps him up too
flatter, punched away to deep point
gives him the charge, ends up yorking himself, and hits it back to the bowler
at the pads again, swept straight to short fine
flighted on the pads, Ganguly misses on the sweep, manages a leg-bye
slower ball, full, driven to deep point
full, driven straight to mid-off
slower ball, driven to extra cover
driven wide of mid-off for a single
on the pads, with fine leg up, Gayle gets the necessary amount of bat on it
offcutter, steered away for a single
gets the yorker right this time, but Ganguly manages a single to long-on
steals a single to midwicket, and Theron's direct-hit costs Punjab an overthrow
yorker turns into a low full toss, but is driven straight to extra cover
overpitched on the pads, worked to wide of Yuvraj at long-on, and they come back for two
Dada makes the Eden go wild, what a lovely clean strike, makes room and gets under the length delivery for a straight six
bouncer tired, hardly comes off the surface, and Ganguly pulls it with ease, making room as he does, in front of square
normal pace and cut away straight to deep point for a single
slower ball outside off, late-cuts it, but finds the short third man
and it's a nice yorker outside off, Ganguly one-bounces it to the keeper
keeps him quiet with a straight delivery with no room, but over-steps
makes room and cuts from just outside off, hit on a half-volley to backward point
Theron's is not the pace to be bowling length wide of off to Ganguly who makes room and places it between cover-point and cover
starts off with a slower one, outside off, sliced to point
swing there, and Gayle gets the outside half of the bat on the drive, the ball goes uppishly past extra cover, wide enough of a diving Piyush Chawla
yorker outside off, Gayle's bat hits the ground, and Bisla lets out Punjab's mandatory unconvincing appeal
slower ball, 117ks, Gayle defends
finally Gayle hits a shot in anger! Charges down at him, and even though he digs it in short, he pulls it disdainfully past midwicket
back of a length, on off again, Gayle looks to drop and run, but he has hit it too much towards Shalabh
starts full and around off, slightly it holds its line, Gayle hits it with the outside half of the bat, to cover
fuller this time, Ganguly looks to sweep but is hit on the pad
nicely hit, makes room, and cuts it from way outside leg stump, through point, and with the line he is bowling all deep fielders are on the on side
closer to the leg stump, flatter too, Ganguly defends
again flighted outside leg, and Gayle plays a sweep for another single
tosses it up even more, Ganguly charges down, ends up yorking himself
tossed up way down the leg side, too full to spin back
flighted on the pads, Gayle sweeps it for a single
sweetly timed, swing is gone, and he pitches up on the pads, and Ganguly meets the ball elegantly, placing it wide of mid-on
shorter delivery, cut away, reaches Mahela at short point on a half-volley
goes for the square-drive this time, can't beat point
crashed past mid-off, makes a bit of room  by clearing the front leg a bit, and then punishes a length ball sans swing
looks for more swing and this goes on with the angle, way down the leg side
slightly shorter, outside off, gets a bottom edge
swing, lovely swing, starts leg and ends up middle, but how long can he keep getting it? That IKP's swing ends in one or two overs is one of Indian cricket's bigger tragedies of the last decade
short ball, and pulled away in front of square, and relief is the first reaction from Mahela, and glee in the dugout
slower ball, and helped along past short fine - lovely shot again, Sanga is smiling finally
punched away in front of square, gets a single
plays with an open face, steals a single to point, Mandeep could have got him, but misses with the direct hit
pushed down to long-on for a single
driven on the up, wide of long-off, Yuvi is the first guy applauding even before he finishes the second. What a beautiful knock! Take a bow, Mahela. The KKR dugout too stands in unison. Respect!
short ball, hurrying him up, way back into the crease, and pulled away wide of deep square leg, puts the dive in to complete the second
full on the pads, worked around the corner for a single
flat delivery, pushed down to long-on for one
one more, this time he goes for the power, slog-sweeps him over wide long-on
Yuvi has come to the party too! low full toss and he has merely flicked it over wide long-on
pushed down the ground for an easy single
super batting, makes room, takes this from outside lg and cuts it between point and short third
short and flat, hit one bounce to wide long-on
misses out on a leg-side half-volley, gets a leg-bye
phew! that missed a yorker by about a foot, and he has check-lofted it for four! No follow through at all, and he has bisected long-on and long-off
short ball, follows him as he looks to back away, but he manages to late-cut it for a single to third man
low full toss, hit down the ground for a single
ho ho ho Yuviiii, where have you been hiding? Length ball, just enough width, and he has sent it soaring behind the midwicket boundary, sweet is the timing
bouncer on the leg-stump line, has Yuvraj ducking
full toss, drilled down to long-on for a single
another slower ball, hit back to the right of Mathews who fields well in his follow through, gets an applause from the crowd
slower ball, on the pads, hit straight to straight midwicket
short, on the pads, and fine leg is too square for this kind of bowling, it doesn't even get rib-high
Mahela's dip in concentration, short and wide, and cut uppishly towards point, on a half-volley
back of a length, on the pads, helped around the corner
another dot ball, pushed straight to straightish extra cover, and Eden Gardens is raising some hell - for dot balls
punched away, but straight to point, and the crowd gets noisier
Bond keeps the game alive! slower ball, but he didn't run his fingers on it. It stops on Sanga, whose check shot carries to Hussey at long-on, who makes no mistake
steered away to third man for a single
superb square-drive! This is very much at home in test cricket! Length ball outside off, and he drives with an open face, past cover-point
full and just outside off, and it holds its line slightly to beat him
pushes this one down to long-on to retain strike
why Mahela why? When he is batting so beautifully, he brings out the ugly reverse-sweep, and is hit in the pads, outside the line of leg
Tiwary misfields! That's surprising. Mahela hits a full toss straight of long-off, and Tiwary makes good ground but doesn't get low enough and lets it slide through
flat-batted one bounce to long-off for a single
and as expected Mahela makes room and chips this past extra cover for one

long hop, Sanga times it rather well, and almost carries to deep midwicket, but Pujara is superb while diving forward. He knows he won't get to it, but gets his body behind it, takes a hit but saves three runs
well done Ajit, India's best fast-bowler fielder since Kapil, perhaps the only good one, dives to his left from sweeper-cover to save two runs. Clean pick-up and throw too
oof beautiful! lovely clean straight strike, and he hardly seemed to have hit it, over long-off, only about five rows back, but that's enough
steps down the pitch and gracefully drives it for one
in the block hole, digs it out for a single
lofted down the ground, straight of long-on, and they come back for two before the fielder can get around
flat delivery, driven towards extra cover, and Tiwary makes a diving save
hit down the ground for a single
digs it in short, and he takes a single to square leg
lovely batting, oof! The classical extra-cover drive, Mahela is on fire, the half-volley didn't help, but what lovely timing and placement

another big moment! Mahela shuffles all the way across, Ajit bowls a straight low full toss, big appeal ensues, but Harper reckons there has been an inside edge on it! Replays inconclusive. On the third replay, I would say there did seem a faint inside edge
back of a length, square-driven square of sweeper-cover, comes back for two
lovely batting by Mahela, slower short ball, Mahela recovers, and steers it fine past keeper, third man has no chance

dropped by Kartik, big moment right here, Mathews bowls full and wide, Mahela looks to steer it past short third, ends up spooning the slower ball straight to short third, and Kartik moves two paces to get in position, but out pops the Kookabura
full, on the pads, nearly a yorker, hit to midwicket for one

what a shot! 100 up, and also 50 for the partnership! Sanga gives him the charge, Mathews bowls the slower one, and it is merely a checked shot, lofted straight over Mathews's head, all the way for six. What clean connection
some luck going Punjab's way in this innings, Sanga goes for the big square drive, gets a thick edge past Saha and fine of third man
slower ball, cut away uppishly, Kartik does well to move to his right at third man to keep them down to one
length ball, crunched away to sweeper-cover for one
and he is beaten outside off again, short it is but doesn't have the width
short and wide and he misses out, had backed away slightly
slower bouncer, outside off, surprises Mahela, who doesn't try to play at it
full on the pads - would have been wide had he not played, would have been four had he got some connection - but they take a leg-bye
good batting again, punched away wide of long-off, and they come back for two
and Sanga is not letting any bowler settle. Down the pitch straight away to Ajit too, and although it's short he manages to chip it over extra cover
yorker, dug out for a single
full toss hit to long-off for a single that brings up his fifty off 26 balls. The dugout stands up in unison for the applause
change of pace - he actually bowled a quick delivery! and bets him outside off
slower short ball, and nicely cut away, wide enough of third man to come back for two
slower ball, low full toss, hit down to long-on for one
and Sanga welcomes compatriot by dancing down the track and lofting him over long-on. Game. Is. On
hit powerfully down the ground, but long-off is straight enough to keep them down to one
smeared into the pads again, gets just a leg-bye
fired down the leg side
back of a length, Mahela tries to manufacture a cut shot and is beaten
full ball, hit to wide of long-on, but can't come back for two
tip-and-run to cover
short, around off, punched away for a single
shot! Mahela is turning it on! Flighted on the pads, and he takes the long-on fielder on, and clears him
shouts of catch it, not hit powerfully, but high enough of Gayle, gets a single to mid-on
fired full into the pads, gets a leg-bye to short third man
flat, into the pads, Mahela is sort of expecting it, and he rocks back and pulls him fine - quick footwork
nice juicy full toss, and Mahela makes room, and drives it through covers, all along the ground
forced away from middle and leg to wide of point for a single
flat ball, pulled away to deep square leg for a single
another arm ball, and through Bisla before his bat comes down. Leg stump gone! Mocking clap from Kartik, along with a few words for a send-off
arm ball, makes room, cuts from outside leg to backward point for one
flat delivery, pushed down to long-on for one
superb hit, comes down the track and absolutely murders this only yards wide of long-off, but so quick it is the fieldsman can't get around
flighted on off, hit down to long-off for one
slower ball again, this time he beats Bisla outside off
slower ball, 11ks, takes the edge, and it dies on Saha, and what's more they take a single
dabs this one down to third man for a single - Unadkat is warned for running on the pitch
and Punjab get some run of luck! Bisla goes for the big slog over midwicket, and the thick outside edge clears Saha's dive
runs this down to third man for a single
lovely shot! Mahela's touches are superb! Length ball on pads, stays still, and lofts it over midwicket. No slogging , no power
short, into the body, too leg sidish, but Mahela misses on the pull shot. Yet they pinch a leg-bye, and the ball hasn't even got out of the batting crease
another slower ball, full ball this time, almost beats him, but the inside edge saves him
slower ball, what slower ball? Bisla makes room, but adjusts well to the change of pace, and goes over mid-off
Bisla looks for his flat-bat in the midwicket region, but this is too full for the shot, and he ends up hitting one bounce to mid-on
slower ball, pushed down to mid-on, and he wants a single and he takes a single
cracker from Mahela! makes slight room, and sends this length ball crashing through the covers, he is actually enjoying Bond's pace on this slow pitch
short ball tried, but down the leg side
runs this length delivery down to third man for a single
length ball on pads, misses out, hitting it straight to square leg, and they steal an overthrow off Kartik's direct-hit - at least third time it has happened today
this one gets big at him, back of a length, pitches around off, and jags back a bit, but they steal a single, dropping it just off the pitch
half-volley angled across him, Mahela walks down the track and hits it straight, right enough of mid-off, another good-looking Mahela shot
fuller, around middle and leg, defended back to Unadkat
welcome Jaydev, short and wide, and Mahela cuts it majestically for four
another slower ball, around off stump, pushed back to the bowler
slower ball, back of a length, worked away for a single
short, into the body, pulled along the ground, gets a single to deep square leg
back of a length, pushed to backward point for a single
short and wide, and a lovely short-arm cut from Mahela, rolling his wrists over it, left of point, right of third man
back of a length, pushed to Kartik at point, and he lets it slip through his legs
